conventions.cleanup: Terminal cleanup is retained as one scalar cost and is not split into components.
conventions.model_seed: Null means the method is not trained and therefore has no training model seed.
conventions.greedy_pairing: All Greedy comparisons use the standalone Greedy formal result joined by test_seed.
conventions.missing_values: Blank CSV cells mean not applicable or not exported; they must not be interpreted as zero.

model_seed.description: Independent training seed; null for non-learning algorithms.
